"The taxes for paying that proportion shall be laid and levied by the authority and direction of the legislatures of the several States within the time agreed upon by the United States in Congress assembled."

In 1789 the US adopted some sort of paper called a "Constitution" which you also may have heard of. It was at that time that the founding fathers realized that you can't really run a country by asking member states to give you donations when they felt like it, so they decide that Congress should be able to "lay and collect taxes, duties, imposts, and excises, pay the Debts and provide for the common Defense and general Welfare of the United States" See, they decided to impose taxes in order to provide defense and welfare....crazy right?
